And has now been approved with a budget of $5,571,643 (approved June 29,1973). The Federal contribution will amount to $4,110,84. The State of Pennsylvania will furnish the remainder. The project is scheduled for an execution period of 60 months. The project has previously received approval for some $484,206 for carrying out the Survey and Planning activities. Part I describes the actions that take place in the $2.8 P stage.
The following sections in Part II contain a great deal of detail information covering the project and the community. A synopsis of the project as it now exists is given at this point to highlight certain salient project information covered later in the text.
